parsed.internal_thinking: Claude is trying to gaslight Gemma by highlighting my hand size (5 Wheat). He's buying development cards to find a way out of his resource bottleneck. I need to maintain Gemma's trust by showing him as the real threat while I quietly accumulate resources for my next expansion.
